title: Aerial-Ground Robot Platform
headline: Reproducible visual-inertial mapping workflows
summary: A systems integration contribution for aerial-ground robotics research, built around ROS 2, VINS, RealSense depth conversion, point clouds, and OctoMap. The project emphasizes validated integration, architecture, provenance, and reproducibility rather than upstream algorithm authorship.
problem: Heterogeneous robot mapping workflows must align odometry, depth, transforms, point clouds, and occupancy mapping across several upstream packages and hardware interfaces.
contribution: An integration and validation layer around ROS 2, VINS, RealSense, TF alignment, point-cloud conversion, and OctoMap, supported by architecture, provenance, and reproducibility documentation.
pipeline: Build the mapping workspace against the documented ROS 2 environment.
Run visual-inertial feature tracking and estimation.
Convert and align depth observations as point clouds.
Integrate aligned observations into OctoMap workflows.
evidence: Architecture documentation for the integrated workspace.
Provenance records for upstream packages and interfaces.
limitations: The repository does not yet include an archived quantitative-results manifest. Reproduction requires the documented ROS 2 environment and relevant hardware or recorded data.
